This document lists the equipment inspection checklist 
 I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the above 
 title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Aziz Elbagoury, tested 
 by eng. Essam EL Sayed EL Razzaz, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Tawfek EL 
 Albasery, accepted by electrical manager eng Mohamed El-lawindy 
 approved by eng Awad Fathy Head sector of Talkha PS, approved by eng. Tawfik 
 El Sayed Tawfik, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
 Soliman admin. & financial inspection & quality control's general 
 director and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control's head 
 sector

A work 
 order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,

items:
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.

Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ...etc.

All Breakers must be disconnected and out of 
 service.
Complete tool set, grease
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes .
Brushes, Blower, mugger device and digital voltmeter .
Clean breaker from any dust.
Check screw connections for tightness.

Grease the 
 Breaker operating mechanism.
Clean arcing contacts by means smooth of file.

Close the Breaker 
 mechanically.
Open the Breaker mechanically.

Check the charging and discharging Breaker 
 manually.
Check the connection of earthing system.
Check cable sockets of Breaker.

Check 
 push buttons , signal lamps, fuses and auxiliary relays.
Check control voltage value.

Check charging and discharging Breaker 
 electrically.

Check operation of breaker from local in test 
 position.

Check operation of breaker from remote in test 
 position.
Check the interlocks for operation of Breaker.
Check interconnection terminals.

Check all protection devices by protection 
 group.

 Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection checklist 
 I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the above 
 title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Aziz Elbagoury, tested 
 by eng. Essam EL Sayed EL Razzaz, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Tawfek EL 
 Albasery, accepted by electrical manager eng Mohamed El-lawindy 
 approved by eng Awad Fathy Head sector of Talkha PS, approved by eng. Tawfik 
 El Sayed Tawfik, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
 Soliman admin. & financial inspection & quality control's general 
 director and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control's head 
 sector
Safety Precautions
A work 
 order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
All Breakers must be disconnected and out of 
 service.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set, grease
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes .
Brushes, Blower, mugger device and digital voltmeter .
Work to be carried out
Clean breaker from any dust.
Check screw connections for tightness.
Grease the 
 Breaker operating mechanism.
Clean arcing contacts by means smooth of file.
Close the Breaker 
 mechanically.
Open the Breaker mechanically.
Check the charging and discharging Breaker 
 manually.
Check the connection of earthing system.
Check cable sockets of Breaker.
Check 
 push buttons , signal lamps, fuses and auxiliary relays.
Check control voltage value.
Check charging and discharging Breaker 
 electrically.
Check operation of breaker from local in test 
 position.
Check operation of breaker from remote in test 
 position.
Check the interlocks for operation of Breaker.
Check interconnection terminals.
Check all protection devices by protection 
 group.

أعد المسودة الأولى م. Abdel Aziz Elbagoury، واختبرها م. Essam EL Sayed EL Razzaz، وراجعها م. Tawfek EL Albasery مهندس مراقبة الجودة في EDEPC، وقبلها م. Mohamed El-lawindy مدير الكهرباء، واعتمدها م. Tawfik El Sayed Tawfik، وصدّق عليها المحاسب Mahmoud Soliman، المدير العام للتفتيش الإداري والمالي ومراقبة الجودة والمشرف على قطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة في EDEPC
يجب إصدار أمر شغل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة الأمن الصناعي المناسبة،

items: يلزم وجود سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل.
ارتدِ مهمات الوقاية مثل خوذة السلامة وحذاء السلامة ... إلخ.
يجب فصل جميع القواطع وإخراجها من الخدمة.
طقم عدد كامل، شحم
قطعة قماش ناعمة لأغراض التنظيف.
فرش، بلور، جهاز ميجر وفولتميتر رقمي.
نظّف القاطع الكهربي من أي أتربة.
افحص إحكام ربط الوصلات اللولبية.
شحّم آلية تشغيل القاطع.
نظّف ملامسات القوس باستخدام مبرد ناعم.
وصّل القاطع ميكانيكيًا.
افصل القاطع ميكانيكيًا.
افحص شحن القاطع الكهربي وتفريغه يدويًا.
افحص توصيل نظام التأريض.
افحص سوكتات كابلات القاطع.
افحص أزرار الضغط ولمبات الإشارة والفيوزات والريليهات المساعدة.
افحص قيمة جهد التحكم.
افحص شحن القاطع الكهربي وتفريغه كهربيًا.
افحص تشغيل القاطع محليًا في وضع الاختبار.
افحص تشغيل القاطع عن بُعد في وضع الاختبار.
افحص التعشيقات الخاصة بتشغيل القاطع.
افحص أطراف التوصيل البينية.
افحص جميع أجهزة الوقاية بواسطة مجموعة الوقاية.
